meta.policy: Globally shared generic icon vocabulary. A motif listed here may be rendered in ANY book world without provenance (it is neither foreign nor ungrounded). Like motif-world.json this is code-owned and unbiblishable. Single-word generic English nouns only; authorship-concept motifs (camelCase) belong in motif-world.json with an explicit owner.
meta.lookupOrder: motif-world.json origins are checked first; only motifs with no registered origin are considered here; everything else must be grounded in the scene's narration/bible vocabulary.
